_note: Copy to the product as docs/delivery/plane.json (plane SPEC §8.1). project_id and language are required: language names the product's language pack (python), which runs the package-doc rules (tune them in a package_docs block) and reads the test output, or none, which turns the package-doc rules off; add an architect block (SPEC §8.1) to turn on the architect seat: house rules, enforced passes, refactor capacity. suite.lanes.gate shows a gate as named stages, run in order until one fails; ccp adds the plane's doc checks as the last stage, so no stage calls ccp (SPEC §14.2). Write your own commands in place of these.
